Name: Dickon Tarly
Quirks: speaks with the unguarded confidence of a son who has his father's approval
is more straightforwardly good-natured than his household's reputation suggests
the fondness for Sam is genuine even when he does not know how to express it
CharacterDescription: Dickon Tarly is the second son of Lord Randyll Tarly of Horn Hill - the son Randyll wanted when Sam was born. He has grown up in his father's full approval, trained to be everything Randyll prizes: strong, martial, capable with a sword. He is in his early teens, still developing, already shaped by his father's satisfaction in a way that contrasts sharply with Sam's experience. He is not cruel - he is simply raised. He likes his brother Sam in an uncomplicated way that his father does not encourage.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Dickon Tarly is the second son and fifth child of Lord Randyll Tarly and Lady Melessa Florent. Since his less martial older brother Samwell has joined the Night's Watch, he is the heir to Horn Hill.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Horn Hill two days before Ned Stark's execution. Sam is at the Wall.
